messages.text:
I received this order on July 5th 2025 and after working up my garden, I planted them on 7/6/25. As of today 8/19/25, not one plant has come up. I’m disappointed yet I do know how hard it is to get milkweed to grow. I did see some tiny roots peeking out of a few of the flower seed balls so I was very hopeful. I did plant them as directed. I thought you’d want to know if your product was successful. Kathy Moe Sent from my iPad
